knowledge:
- key_parameters: profileFile=Path to the individual's genotyping profile (VCF or generic format) ;; pathProfileGDS=Directory path where the individual's GDS file will be created ;; fileReferenceGDS=Path to the population reference GDS file ;; fileReferenceAnnotGDS=Path to the population reference SNV Annotation GDS file ;; chrInfo=Chromosome length information vector ;; syntheticRefDF=Data frame containing selected reference profiles for data synthesis ;; genoSource=Format of the input genotype file, either "VCF" or "generic" ;; blockTypeID=For RNA data, the identifier of the block group (e.g., "GeneS.Ensembl.Hsapiens.v86")
- alternatives: VariationAnnotation=Mentioned for extracting genotype/phase information from VCF files, but warns it may use a lot of memory ;; GENESIS=Mentioned for computing kinship coefficients to identify unrelated profiles and for obtaining block information
- when_to_use: Appropriate when inferring genetic ancestry from human molecular data other than whole-genome or whole-exome sequences of cancer-free DNA, such as targeted gene panels, RNA-seq, and cancer-derived nucleic acids
- pitfalls: Using the provided "mini-reference" files (ex1_good_small_1KG.gds) for real ancestry inference will yield unreliable results ;; Extracting genotype/phase information from VCF files using VariationAnnotation can consume a large amount of memory ;; Related profiles in the reference GDS file must be flagged and discarded using the sample.ref field ;; The starting position in the population reference GDS file is zero (like BED files), so generic SNP files must also start at position zero ;; Input VCF files must be gzipped

workflows.name: dna_ancestry_inference
workflows.intent: Infer genetic ancestry from DNA sequencing data (WGS, exome, panels) using profile-specific parameter optimization.
input: ex1.vcf.gz (gzipped VCF file containing germline variants with GT, AD, and DP fields)
ex1_good_small_1KG_Annot.gds (Population Reference SNV Annotation GDS file)
workflows.stages: 1. Set up the working directory structure and copy reference files ;; 2. Select reference profiles for data synthesis using select1KGPopForSynthetic ;; 3. Load chromosome length information from BSgenome ;; 4. Run ancestry inference and parameter optimization using inferAncestry ;; 5. Inspect results and visualize performance using createAUROCGraph
workflows.code:
pathWorkingDirectory <- file.path(tempdir(), "workingDirectory")
pathWorkingDirectoryData <- file.path(pathWorkingDirectory, "data")
if (!dir.exists(pathWorkingDirectory)) {
    dir.create(pathWorkingDirectory)
    dir.create(pathWorkingDirectoryData)
    dir.create(file.path(pathWorkingDirectoryData, "refGDS"))
    dir.create(file.path(pathWorkingDirectoryData, "profileGDS"))
}

dataDir <- system.file("extdata", package="RAIDS")
pathReference <- file.path(dataDir, "tests")
fileGDS <- file.path(pathReference, "ex1_good_small_1KG.gds")
fileAnnotGDS <- file.path(pathReference, "ex1_good_small_1KG_Annot.gds")

file.copy(fileGDS, file.path(pathWorkingDirectoryData, "refGDS"))
file.copy(fileAnnotGDS, file.path(pathWorkingDirectoryData, "refGDS"))

pathReference <- file.path(pathWorkingDirectoryData, "refGDS")
refGenotype <- file.path(pathReference, "ex1_good_small_1KG.gds")
refAnnotation <- file.path(pathReference, "ex1_good_small_1KG_Annot.gds")

pathProfileGDS <- file.path(pathWorkingDirectoryData, "profileGDS")
if (!dir.exists(pathProfileGDS)) {
    dir.create(pathProfileGDS)
}

set.seed(3043)
dataRef <- select1KGPopForSynthetic(fileReferenceGDS=refGenotype, nbProfiles=2L)

if (requireNamespace("Seqinfo", quietly=TRUE) && requireNamespace("BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38", quietly=TRUE)) {
    genome <- BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38::Hsapiens
    chrInfo <- Seqinfo::seqlengths(genome)[1:25]
    fileDonorVCF <- file.path(dataDir, "example", "snpPileup", "ex1.vcf.gz")
    resOut <- inferAncestry(profileFile=fileDonorVCF, pathProfileGDS=pathProfileGDS, fileReferenceGDS=refGenotype, fileReferenceAnnotGDS=refAnnotation, chrInfo=chrInfo, syntheticRefDF=dataRef, genoSource=c("VCF"))
}

class(resOut)
names(resOut)
print(resOut$Ancestry)
createAUROCGraph(dfAUROC=resOut$paraSample$dfAUROC, title="Example ex1")

workflows.name: rna_ancestry_inference
workflows.intent: Infer genetic ancestry from RNA sequencing data using gene-aware block annotations and profile-specific parameter optimization.
input: demoPedigreeEx1 (Profile PED data frame containing Name.ID, Case.ID, Sample.Type, Diagnosis, Source)
studyDF (Study data frame containing study.id, study.desc, study.platform)
ex1_good_small_1KG_Annot.gds (Population Reference SNV Annotation GDS file)
snpPileupRNA (Directory containing gzipped Profile SNP VCF files)
workflows.stages: 1. Load pedigree information and study metadata ;; 2. Open reference GDS and select reference profiles using select1KGPop ;; 3. Load chromosome length information from BSgenome ;; 4. Run RNA ancestry inference using runRNAAncestry with blockTypeID specified ;; 5. Read and inspect the output ancestry CSV file
workflows.code:
library(RAIDS)
library(gdsfmt)

dataDir <- system.file("extdata", package="RAIDS")
data(demoPedigreeEx1)
head(demoPedigreeEx1)

pathReference <- file.path(dataDir, "tests")
fileGDS <- file.path(pathReference, "ex1_good_small_1KG.gds")
fileAnnotGDS <- file.path(pathReference, "ex1_good_small_1KG_Annot.gds")

studyDF <- data.frame(study.id="MYDATA", study.desc="Description", study.platform="PLATFORM", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
pathGeno <- file.path(dataDir, "example", "snpPileupRNA")

set.seed(3043)
gds1KG <- snpgdsOpen(fileGDS)
dataRef <- select1KGPop(gds1KG, nbProfiles=2L)
closefn.gds(gds1KG)

if (requireNamespace("Seqinfo", quietly=TRUE) && requireNamespace("BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38", quietly=TRUE)) {
    chrInfo <- Seqinfo::seqlengths(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38::Hsapiens)[1:25]
    pathProfileGDS <- file.path(tempdir(), "exampleRNA", "outRNA.tmp")
    pathOut <- file.path(tempdir(), "exampleRNA", "resRNA.out")
    
    if (!dir.exists(file.path(tempdir(), "exampleRNA"))) {
        dir.create(file.path(tempdir(), "exampleRNA"))
        dir.create(pathProfileGDS)
        dir.create(pathOut)
        
        runRNAAncestry(pedStudy=demoPedigreeEx1, studyDF=studyDF, pathProfileGDS=pathProfileGDS, pathGeno=pathGeno, pathOut=pathOut, fileReferenceGDS=fileGDS, fileReferenceAnnotGDS=fileAnnotGDS, chrInfo=chrInfo, syntheticRefDF=dataRef, blockTypeID="GeneS.Ensembl.Hsapiens.v86", genoSource="VCF")
        
        resAncestry <- read.csv(file.path(pathOut, paste0(demoPedigreeEx1$Name.ID[1], ".Ancestry.csv")))
        print(resAncestry)
    }
}
